style: Photograph of a vintage explorer's notebook lying open on a dark wooden desk, seen from above at a slight three-quarter angle, soft daylight from a window at the upper left, long soft shadows, shallow depth of field at the far edges. Ivory paper with a fine grain, slightly warm, clean (no stains, no burnt edges). Illustrations on the pages are watercolor washes and fine ink line drawings with graphite construction lines and small night-blue ink notes. Palette: ivory, pale limestone, graphite grey, night-blue ink, discreet brass, a few Mediterranean blue accents; golden light only where stated. Photorealistic materials, editorial restraint, the quality of a fine illustrated atlas.
negative: No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no pins, no buttons, no cards, no user interface, no hands, no people, no sepia filter, no heavy vignette, no fantasy ornaments.

shots.prompt: Same notebook, same desk, same lighting and camera as the reference. Both pages of the open spread are EMPTY ivory paper with only faint graphite grid lines and a few pencil construction circles in the margins. No map, no drawings, no text. Around the book on the desk: a brass compass at the left edge, a small stack of old photographic prints at the right edge, a pencil. This image is a background plate: everything on the pages will be drawn by software.

Flat scan, exactly top-down, no perspective, no shadows, no desk: a watercolor world map painted on ivory paper, centred on the Pacific Ocean (Americas on the right, Asia and Africa on the left, Europe at the upper left), pale sage and ochre continents with soft edges, pale blue-grey oceans, fine ink coastlines, graphite graticule lines. No country borders, no names, no text, no pins. The paper fills the whole frame edge to edge.

Fine ink line drawing with light graphite shading of a single Easter Island moai head and shoulders, seen from the front-left, in the style of a nineteenth-century explorer's field sketch. Isolated on a transparent background. No text.

Fine ink line drawing with light graphite shading of a Maya stepped pyramid with its temple on top, seen from a low three-quarter angle, explorer's field sketch, a few construction lines left visible. Isolated on a transparent background. No text.

Fine ink line drawing with light graphite shading of three tall carved T-shaped stone pillars standing in a circle, as at an early Neolithic sanctuary, explorer's field sketch. Isolated on a transparent background. No text.

Fine ink line drawing with a touch of watercolor of a small Pacific islet with two palm trees and a low basalt wall at the waterline, explorer's field sketch. Isolated on a transparent background. No text.
